title: Wayfare Pass Membership Terms — One Membership per Customer
content:
# One membership per customer (Wayfare Pass)

**Clause.** A customer may hold only one Wayfare Pass (rider membership) membership at a time. A new enrollment is accepted only when the customer has no membership in enrolled, trial, active, past due, paused or pending cancellation status; a customer whose membership is cancelled may enroll again, subject to the trial rules. Moving between plans is a plan change on the existing membership, never a second enrollment.

## Basis of the judgement

- **Limit**: 1 open membership per customer.
- **What is checked**: the Wayfare Pass memberships on record for the same customer, and the status each one shows. The system record decides; it is read before the enrollment is made.
- **Object**: the customer who would enroll. Memberships of other customers play no part.

## Status table for a new enrollment

The clause names the statuses that block a new enrollment ("only when"), so the table below is complete.

| Status of an existing membership of the same customer | New enrollment accepted? |
|---|---|
| enrolled | no |
| trial | no |
| active | no |
| past due | no |
| paused | no |
| pending cancellation | no |
| cancelled | yes, subject to the trial rules |
| no membership on record | yes |

## Hypothetical cases

1. A customer whose only membership is paused asks to enroll in a second plan: the paused membership is open, so the enrollment is not accepted.
2. A customer whose earlier membership is cancelled enrolls again: the enrollment is accepted, and whether a free trial comes with it follows the trial rules.
3. A member on one plan wants another plan: that is a plan change on the existing membership, not a new enrollment.
